messages:
frances: opened a compact PR to add an audit checklist for header changes + a tiny PromQL sanity check. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5120

leo: Nice. Can we include one-line curl/python/node examples and a minimal before->after header diff? People want copy-paste.

frances: done. Before: `X-Redwood-Tier: silver` After: `x-redwood-quota-tier: silver`. Curl: `curl -H 'x-redwood-quota-tier: silver' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

anya: Add a one-liner PromQL so infra teams can validate: `sum by(tier_label) (increase(billing.tier_assigned[7d]))` with short note: "counts assignments per tier over 7 days".

rahul: Quick prod nuance: Dedicated accounts apply reserve first. Add a parenthetical note and tag eng for metric name verification.

frances: Added note and pinged @eng-runtime to confirm metric names for Dedicated dashboards. Also added a small migration checklist at the top: pin SDK >=0.9.2, update headers, smoke test against staging.

leo: Recommend lowercase headers in all examples and a troubleshooting tip: "If tiers don't change, check proxy header normalization."

anya: LGTM. docs-bot: can you create a preview after the eng metric name is confirmed?

docs-bot: Deploy preview posted: https://deploy-preview-5120--docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits/audit-checklist (preview expires in 7 days).

rahul: Eng-runtime confirmed Dedicated metric is `billing.dedicated_reserve_used`. Added link to Dedicated metrics page.

frances: Thanks all 389 merging in 10m if no objections. I'll follow up with a small PR to attach the dashboard thumbnail and an example cost impact table.
